lines.text: This is the biggest volcano in the solar system.
lines.cue: caption: BIGGEST IN THE SOLAR SYSTEM

lines.text: It's called Olympus Mons, and it's on Mars.
It rises between twenty-two and twenty-six kilometres above the plains around it.
That's two and a half to three Everests.
Its base is wider than Arizona.
The slopes are only two to five degrees, so you'd hardly know you were climbing.
On Earth, the highest peak above the sea stops short of nine kilometres.
Earth's mountains hit a ceiling. This one sailed straight through it.
So what does Mars have that Earth doesn't? The full video on our channel has the answer. Like and subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
